description: This file defines a custom RuntimeException class used within the Fineract project to signal invalid product-to-GL account mapping scenarios. It extends an abstract platform exception and provides a constructor that generates a detailed error message.

classes.name: ProductToGLAccountMappingInvalidException
classes.description: A custom runtime exception indicating invalid product to GL account mappings, used to be thrown when such mapping inconsistencies are detected.

methods.name: ProductToGLAccountMappingInvalidException
methods.description: Constructor that creates an exception instance with a detailed message about the invalid account mapping given parameters such as parameter name, account name, account ID, actual category, and expected category.
